scenes.say: He's a Grand Prix winner, and he still has no team for twenty twenty-seven.
Esteban Ocon won the twenty twenty-one Hungarian Grand Prix with Alpine. It's still his only win.
More than ten years in Formula One: Manor, Force India, Alpine and now Haas.
Haas rate his speed but wanted more consistency. Rookie Rafael Câmara takes his seat.
Ocon calls himself a free agent. If no race seat comes up, he's ready to be a reserve driver.
He's thirty, and he has no plans to leave Formula One.
Every team's line-up is on LapRadar.

title: Esteban Ocon leaves Haas: a Grand Prix winner without a 2027 seat
